Use JavaScript for 95% of use cases.  
Python in n8n has **NO external libraries** (no requests, pandas, numpy).  
Use JavaScript for HTTP requests ($helpers.httpRequest available), Luxon, transformations, or when in doubt.  
Data: `_input.all()`, `_input.first()`, `_input.item`; webhook: `_json["body"]`; `_node["Name"]`.  
Return Format: Must return `[{"json": {...}}]`.  
Use `.get()` for dictionaries (avoid KeyError); check lengths before indexing (avoid IndexError); use standard library only (no external imports); handle empty input (`if items:`).  
Use n8n nodes when libraries needed.  
Python uses code syntax, not {{}} expressions.
